# Fused-megakernel component contract (portability spec)

Owner requirement (2026-06-09): every (model × optimizer × arch) configuration —
all 3 models × 11 optimizers — composes into ONE persistent megakernel binary,
and the building blocks are **individually portable**: a third project lifts the
headers and instantiates a fused trainer without dragging this repo along. The
meta-programming lives in headers; the dispatch layer is generated and is the
only composition seam.

## Component taxonomy (header-only, self-contained)

| component | header(s) | contract |
|---|---|---|
| **Substrate** | `csrc/fused/megakernel_common.cuh` | `PersistentContext` (task counter, grid barrier, generation), one-CTA-per-SM persistent launch idiom. Depends on CUDA runtime only. |
| **Optimizer math** | `csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h` (×11) | Pure per-element apply math (`<opt>_step(...)`), no CUDA dependencies beyond `__device__` qualifiers, no state allocation, no I/O. Single source of truth — everything else `#include`s these (enforced by `scripts/check_math_single_source.py`). Already portable as-is. |
| **Optimizer tails** | `csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_components.cuh` | `apply_optimizer<OptId>(FusedOptState&, FusedScalars const&, ...)` — templates composing the algorithm headers into megakernel stages. Consumes the documented POD structs only. |
| **Model stages** | `csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_<model>.cuh` (decoder / vit / mamba3 — ONE HEADER PER MODEL, not a monolith) | Provides `model_<m>_forward_stage<Dims>` and `model_<m>_backward_stage<Dims>`: batch-slice-local fwd/bwd with all activations CTA-local, writing per-CTA weight-grad partials to a caller-provided workspace. Templated on compile-time dims (d_model, n_layers, n_heads, seq, vocab). Includes ONLY the substrate header + CUDA. No globals, no repo build flags (every `SG_TUNED_*` consumed via `#ifndef` defaults). |
| **Composition** | `csrc/fused/sm_90/fused_megakernel.cuh` | `launch_fused_megakernel<ModelId, OptId, Tier>` — stage pipeline: fwd → bwd → grid barrier → deterministic weight-grad reduction → optimizer tail. The only place stages and tails meet. |
| **Cells** | `csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_<model>_<opt>.cu` (×33) | GENERATED 36-line instantiations (`megakernel_codegen.py`). Never hand-edited. |
| **Dispatch** | `csrc/bindings/dispatch.cpp` + generated `fused_wired_cells.inc` / `fused_dispatch_table.inc` | `(model, optimizer, arch) → cell` routing. Generated from the same enumeration as the cells, so it cannot drift. Loud-gated: unwired/unready cells throw, never silently degrade. |

## Portability rules (apply to every new/edited component)
1. **Self-containment**: a component header compiles with `#include <cuda_runtime.h>`
   + its declared includes only. Include-what-you-use; no transitive reliance.
2. **No hidden state**: no globals, no statics with side effects; all state flows
   through the documented POD structs (`PersistentContext`, `FusedOptState`,
   `FusedScalars`) or explicit pointers.
3. **Compile-time configuration only via documented template params or
   `#ifndef`-defaulted macros** (`SG_TUNED_*`); absent definitions must yield a
   correct (if untuned) kernel.
4. **The lift test**: copying `megakernel_common.cuh` + one `model_stage_*.cuh`
   + `opt_components.cuh` + the relevant `csrc/algorithms/*.h` into a fresh
   project and instantiating `launch_fused_megakernel<M,O,Tier>` must build and
   run. Each phase's validation includes compiling a minimal out-of-tree TU
   (tests/hw/test_component_portability.cu) that includes ONLY those headers.
5. **Generated artifacts are never edited by hand** — change the generator,
   regenerate everything, `git diff` must be generator-consistent.
6. **No placeholder math** on any wired path (owner no-suppression directive);
   surrogate stages exist only behind explicit unreadiness gates and throw at
   dispatch.

## Phase status

> **Boundary (per `HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md` §2, 2026-06-09):** the L3 fused
> model×optimizer megacells are **compile-verified only** on sm_90 — the
> on-silicon H100 race exercises the eager model + fused-*optimizer* (L1) path,
> not the L3 megakernel, so "validated vs eager" below remains the open gate for
> every phase. No phase is silicon-complete.

- Phase 1 (in flight): real decoder fwd+bwd stages. The per-model split has
  landed (`model_stage_decoder*.cuh` + `fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh` exist per
  this contract); the **validated-vs-eager** gate is still open — these stages
  are compile-verified only (§2), not yet runtime/numeric-checked on silicon.
- Phase 2: vit + mamba3 stage headers (`model_stage_{vit,mamba3}*.cuh` +
  `fused_{vit,mamba}_megakernel.cuh` present, built against this contract
  natively); same compile-verified-only boundary applies.
- Phase 3: optimizer precompute stages in-kernel for the 9 non-trivial tails;
  SuperGrok2's CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta as in-kernel stages (the full
  "vit×sg2 in one binary").

110	// Rebase a FusedOptState's per-element state pointers to a parameter-tensor slice
111	// at `off` within the flat [m|v|extra] layout. Per-TENSOR fields and all scalars
112	// pass through unchanged. (Identical to the decoder's rebase_state; redefined here
113	// under a mamba_ name so this header stays self-contained — the decoder file is
114	// owned by a sibling agent and must not be included.)
115	template <OptId Opt>
116	__device__ __forceinline__ FusedOptState
117	mamba_rebase_state(const FusedOptState& s, int64_t off) {
118	    FusedOptState t = s;  // scalars + per-tensor pointers copy as-is
119	    if (t.exp_avg)    t.exp_avg    += off;
120	    if (t.exp_avg_sq) t.exp_avg_sq += off;
121	    if (t.ema)        t.ema        += off;
122	    if (t.sam_dir)    t.sam_dir    += off;
123	    if (t.s_track)    t.s_track    += off;
124	    if (t.mu)         t.mu         += off;
125	    if (t.orth)       t.orth       += off;
126	    if (t.smart_grad) t.smart_grad += off;
127	    if (t.param_init) t.param_init += off;   // Prodigy trajectory anchor p0 (per-tensor
128	                                             // slice). prodigy_persist is a GLOBAL 3-
129	                                             // scalar [r_ema|s_ema|d_lr] — NOT rebased.
130	    return t;
131	}

133	// The L3-REAL Mamba megakernel needs the int TOKEN path + a grad-partial
134	// workspace. Kept a SEPARATE kernel + launcher (not folded into the surrogate
135	// fused_megakernel) so the surrogate path is untouched. MambaTokenCtx mirrors the
136	// decoder's DecoderTokenCtx (int tokens, NOT ViT's float patches).
137	//
138	// Workspace layout (one flat float buffer the host allocates + the kernel owns):
139	//   [0 .. nCTA*total)              : per-CTA grad partials (cta-major)
140	//   [nCTA*total .. nCTA*total+nCTA): per-CTA loss partials (NLL sum per slice)
141	//   [.. +1)                        : the reduced scalar loss (loss/B) the host reads
142	// total == kMambaTotalElems == 259425.
143	struct MambaTokenCtx {
144	    const int* tokens;   // [B, kSeq] int32 token ids in [0, kVocab)
145	    const int* targets;  // [B]       int32 target ids in [0, kPHead)
146	    int        B;        // batch size
147	    float*     workspace; // grad partials + loss partials + reduced loss
148	    float*     loss_out;  // device float the kernel writes the mean loss into
149	};
150	
151	// ── The persistent megakernel (L3-REAL). gridDim.x = #SMs (one CTA/SM), 256
152	//    threads/CTA. MambaSampleSmem (~141.72 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (extern). ──
153	// sizes/offsets are NOT host-passed: per-tensor numel/offset live in the
154	// __constant__ tables kMambaSizes/kMambaOffsets (mamba3_layout.cuh), read directly
155	// by the reduce + optimizer phases.
156	template <OptId Opt>
157	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK)
158	fused_mamba_megakernel(PersistentContext ctx,
159	                       float* __restrict__ params,
160	                       MambaTokenCtx tok,
161	                       float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
162	                       float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
163	    extern __shared__ char mamba_smem_raw[];
164	    MambaSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<MambaSampleSmem*>(mamba_smem_raw);
165	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
166	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
167	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
168	    const int64_t total = kMambaTotalElems;
169	    float* my_partial = tok.workspace + (int64_t)cta * total;   // this CTA's dW
170	    float* loss_part = tok.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]
171	
172	    // NO warp-group register repartition here (UNLIKE the decoder/vit seams).
173	    // The decoder/vit copy a §3.4 producer/consumer setmaxnreg (dealloc<32> on
174	    // warpgroup 0, alloc<200> on warpgroup 1) — valid ONLY when warpgroup 0 needs
175	    // few registers. Mamba is NOT warp-specialized that way: ALL 256 threads do
176	    // SYMMETRIC selective-scan work, each thread owning a channel j∈[0,256) and
177	    // holding large register-resident scan state (fwd A[16]+h[16]; bwd adds
178	    // hh[kSeq+1][kState]+a_save[kSeq][kState]+dB_loc/dC_loc[kSeq][kState]+gh+dA),
179	    // so a dealloc<32> would spill it. __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK) sets the uniform
180	    // budget; the compiler allocates symmetrically across all 256 threads.
181	
182	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
183	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
184	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
185	    bar.sync();   // B0
186	
187	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
188	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
189	    MambaGrad g = mb_bind_grad(my_partial);
190	    const int B = tok.B;
191	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
192	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
193	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
194	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
195	    __shared__ int tok_s[mb::kSeq];   // this sample's token ids (broadcast)
196	    __shared__ int tgt_s;
197	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
198	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
199	        if (threadIdx.x < mb::kSeq) tok_s[threadIdx.x] = tok.tokens[(int64_t)b * mb::kSeq + threadIdx.x];
200	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = tok.targets[b];
201	        __syncthreads();
202	        float nll = mb_forward_sample(w, tok_s, tgt_s, &sm);
203	        mb_backward_sample(w, g, tok_s, tgt_s, B, &sm);
204	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
205	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
206	    }
207	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
208	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
209	
210	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
211	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
212	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
213	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
214	    {
215	        __shared__ int task_slot;
216	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
217	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
218	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
219	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
220	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
221	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
222	                float acc = 0.0f;
223	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
224	                    acc += tok.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
225	                grad[off + i] = acc;
226	            }
227	        }
228	    }
229	    // Loss reduction (fp64 ordered) by CTA 0 only — the loss rel-tol is the
230	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
231	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
232	        double s = 0.0;
233	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
234	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
235	        *tok.loss_out = mean;
236	    }
237	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3
238	
239	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 28
240	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
241	    st.lr = lr;
242	    {
243	        __shared__ int task_slot;
244	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
245	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
246	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
247	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
248	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
249	            const FusedOptState ts = mamba_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);
250	            float* __restrict__ p = params + off;
251	            const float* __restrict__ gg = grad + off;
252	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x)
253	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);
254	        }
255	    }
256	}

258	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
259	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
260	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the Mamba footprint requires
261	//    (exactly as launch_fused_vit_megakernel does):
262	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, kMambaSmemBytes)
263	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes in the occ≥1 query
264	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes at <<<...>>>
265	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
266	template <OptId Opt>
267	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel(
268	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
269	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
270	    int dev = 0;
271	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
272	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
273	    int n_sms = 0;
274	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
275	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
276	
277	    const int dyn_smem = (int)kMambaSmemBytes;   // 145124 B (≈141.72 KB)
278	
279	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
280	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
281	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
282	        (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>,
283	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
284	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
285	
286	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
287	    int occ = 0;
288	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
289	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
290	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
291	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
292	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
293	    // satisfied. ~141.72 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 ~227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
294	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
295	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
296	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
297	           "fused_mamba_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
298	           "Mamba per-sample smem (~142KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
299	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
300	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
301	
302	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
303	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
304	
305	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
306	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
307	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
308	
309	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
310	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
311	    fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
312	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
313	    return cudaGetLastError();
314	}

351	// ── PHASE PROFILER (default OFF; a separate measurement TU defines
352	//    SG_MB_TC_PROFILE to bracket P1-fwd/P1-bwd/P2/P3 with clock64() and write
353	//    per-CTA cumulative cycles to a profiling buffer carved from the workspace
354	//    tail). Production builds never define it → zero added code, zero ABI change.
355	#ifndef SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
356	#define SG_MB_TC_PROFILE 0
357	#endif
358	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
359	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS 8   // [p1fwd,p1bwd,p2,p3, p2-dwgemm,p2-reduce,p2-embed, witness]
360	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(v) do { __syncthreads(); if (threadIdx.x == 0) (v) = clock64(); } while (0)
361	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(slot, t0) do { __syncthreads(); \
362	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) prof[(int64_t)cta * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS + (slot)] += (double)(clock64() - (t0)); } while (0)
363	#else
364	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(v) do {} while (0)
365	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(slot, t0) do {} while (0)

368	// ── Static smem arena: kMbTcStages A(64×16) + kMbTcStages B(N×16) bf16 tiles
369	//    (the GEMM K-loop double-buffer ring — slot s at sA + s*64*16 / sB +
370	//    s*N*16) + the 256-float reduction slot + the scan-bwd cross-channel reduce
371	//    targets (dBmat/dCmat, [kSeq×kState] each) + the 8 dW specs (shared, not
372	//    per-thread stack). At S=2 + N=128 the ring is 2·(2KB+4KB)=12KB; MbTcSmem
373	//    total ~14.6KB ≪ the 48KB static cap (the TC launcher uses static smem). ──
374	struct MbTcSmem {
375	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[mbtc::kMbTcStages * 64 * 16];
376	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[mbtc::kMbTcStages * SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
377	    float red[256];
378	    float dBmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
379	    float dCmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
380	    mbtc::MbDwSpec spec[8];
381	};

383	// TC workspace layout (carved from tok.workspace; host sizes it):
384	//   [0 .. acts_f)                          : MbActs bf16 region
385	//   [acts_f .. + nCTA*scratch)             : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
386	//   [.. + nCTA*kPartElems)                 : per-CTA non-GEMM grad partials (f32)
387	//   [.. + nCTA)                            : per-CTA loss slots
388	//   [.. + 1)                               : reduced scalar loss
389	//   [.. + mb_dw_part_floats(G))            : split-K dW partials (G>1 only; the
390	//                                            (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles P2 reduces)
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_acts_floats(int T) {
392	    return mbtc::mb_acts_floats(T);
393	}
394	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
395	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_dw_part_floats() {
396	    return (mbtc::kMbDwSplitK > 1) ? mbtc::mb_dw_part_floats(mbtc::kMbDwSplitK) : 0;
397	}
398	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). Mirrors the
399	// decoder's dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats: the Prodigy P2.6 stage publishes per-CTA (r,s)
400	// slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d broadcast slot (1) — an owner-computes tree
401	// (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST nCTA (one
402	// CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 ≈ 1 KB) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so the opt-
403	// agnostic cached launcher workspace fits every OptId. Unused by AdamW/Lion/… (their
404	// P3 never touches this region), so adding it leaves those cells byte-identical.
405	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
406	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
407	}
408	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int nCTA) {
409	    return mb_tc_acts_floats(T)
410	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_floats()
411	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::kPartElems
412	         + nCTA + 1
413	         + mb_tc_dw_part_floats()                       // split-K dW partials (G>1)
414	         + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)                // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
415	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
416	         + (int64_t)nCTA * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS * 2 + 2  // phase-profiler (doubles=2 floats) + align pad
417	#endif
418	         ;
419	}

421	template <OptId Opt>
422	__global__ void SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS
423	fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
424	                          float* __restrict__ params,
425	                          MambaTokenCtx tok,
426	                          float* __restrict__ grad,
427	                          float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
428	    __shared__ MbTcSmem sm;
429	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
430	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
431	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
432	    const int B = tok.B;

704	// Launcher (static-smem; the decoder TC contract). ncta_cap>0 caps the launched
705	// CTAs (the per-CTA scratch is nCTA×slab; a memory-tight TEST caps it). Grid
706	// barrier rendezvous is over the LAUNCHED count → hang-safe; determinism is per
707	// fixed nCTA (dW-tile / partial / embed owner maps read ctx.n_ctas). B%16 req.
708	// Host helper: the EXACT CTA count launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<Opt> will use
709	// (occ·n_sms with occupancy-fill, or the cap). The caller MUST size the workspace
710	// with this — the per-CTA scratch/partials are nCTA·slab, so sizing for n_sms while
711	// the launcher runs occ·n_sms would overflow. Returns 0 on a CUDA-attr failure (the
712	// caller should treat that as "fall back to a conservative larger size").
713	template <OptId Opt>
714	int mb_tc_launched_nctas(int dev, int ncta_cap) {
715	    int n_sms = 0;
716	    if (cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev) != cudaSuccess) return 0;
717	    int occ = 0;
718	    if (cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
719	            &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<Opt>, SG_MB_TC_MEGA_BLOCK, 0) != cudaSuccess)
720	        return 0;
721	    if (occ < 1) return 0;
722	    unsigned waves = (SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM >= 2 && occ > 1) ? (unsigned)occ : 1u;
723	    unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms * waves;
724	    if (ncta_cap > 0 && (unsigned)ncta_cap < launch_ctas) launch_ctas = (unsigned)ncta_cap;
725	    return (int)launch_ctas;
726	}

728	template <OptId Opt>
729	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(
730	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
731	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream,
732	        int ncta_cap = 0) {
733	    int dev = 0;
734	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
735	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
736	    int n_sms = 0;
737	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
738	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
739	
740	    int occ = 0;
741	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
742	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<Opt>, SG_MB_TC_MEGA_BLOCK,
743	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/0);
744	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
745	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
746	
747	    // OCCUPANCY-FILL: at min-blocks≥2 the kernel is built ≤128 reg/thread so `occ`
748	    // CTAs co-reside per SM. Launch occ·n_sms CTAs (one full residency set) so the
749	    // co-resident CTAs hide each other's HBM latency across the scan/conv/LN phases
750	    // that run fully exposed at occ=1 — the persistent grid barrier rendezvous is
751	    // over the LAUNCHED count and occ·n_sms are guaranteed simultaneously resident,
752	    // so it stays hang-free. Determinism is per fixed launched nCTA (ascending-CTA
753	    // reduce). At min-blocks==1 (shipped default) occ==1 → identical to before.
754	    unsigned waves = (SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM >= 2 && occ > 1) ? (unsigned)occ : 1u;
755	    unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms * waves;
756	    if (ncta_cap > 0 && (unsigned)ncta_cap < launch_ctas) launch_ctas = (unsigned)ncta_cap;
757	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
758	    // B%16: the dW K-loop contracts K=T=B·8 in 16-step atoms. It ALSO guarantees
759	    // FULL tiles (T%kTileM==0 for kTileM∈{64,128}), which the projection GEMMs
760	    // REQUIRE — they process a compile-time M-extent of kTileM rows (kAtomsM
761	    // atoms), NOT the runtime `nrows`; a partial final tile would feed garbage
762	    // pad rows to the wgmma while the scalar scan/conv loops process only nsamp.
763	    // (A future relaxation to B%2 would satisfy the K-atom reason but silently
764	    // break partial tiles — keep B%16.)

"""tests/hw/test_l3tc_tail_gate.py — per-cell L3-TC conversion gate (owner baseline).

The owner baseline directive's per-cell gates for a newly-converted L3-TC cell:
  (1) megakernel-vs-eager single-step  — the in-kernel optimizer TAIL must match a
      reference apply of the SAME canonical update on the SAME TC-reduced grad.
  (2) A/A/A determinism                — the production L3-TC step is bit-identical
      across 3 runs from the same init (fixed tile ownership + ascending-k/t reduce).

WHY THIS SHAPE (not a full loss-trajectory-vs-eager oracle): the bf16 wgmma fwd+bwd
and the deterministic grad reduction are SHARED with the already-gated adamw TC cell
(decoder 13/13+5, vit 21/21, mamba 5/5 — grad parity vs the bf16-faithful oracle).
A converted cell changes ONLY the per-element tail (apply_optimizer<Opt>), which is
the 14/0-apply-parity math. So the cell-specific NEW surface is exactly the tail, and
the right gate is "did the kernel's tail apply the canonical update to the reduced
grad correctly" — which is (1). The grad itself is validated by the adamw gates +
the determinism check (2) proves no race was introduced by the tail swap.

The reference apply is the canonical CPU math (transcribed from csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h
— the SAME single source the kernel's apply_optimizer<Opt> calls), run on the grad the
kernel returns (fused_train_step(return_grad=True)). fp32 both sides → tight tol.

Run:
  PYTHONPATH=. python -m tests.hw.test_l3tc_tail_gate                 # all converted
  PYTHONPATH=. python -m tests.hw.test_l3tc_tail_gate --cell lion/decoder
  PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest tests/hw/test_l3tc_tail_gate.py -q
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def _g():
    if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
    import grokking_race_v2 as g
    return g


# Cell spec: model, race optimizer key, and a factory that builds the REAL eager
# optimizer with the EXACT production hyperparameters (the SAME ones train_<opt> uses).
# The gate references this LIVE optimizer (not a header re-transcription), so it catches
# any mechanism the real optimizer has that apply_optimizer<Opt> drops (grad_clip,
# per-layer schedules, adaptive alpha) — the "megakernel-vs-REAL-eager" the directive
# means. State layout in fused_train_step is [m|v|extra].
def _adamw_factory(g, params, c):
    # train_adamw: torch.optim.AdamW(lr, betas=(beta1,beta2), weight_decay, fused=True)
    import torch
    return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=c["lr"], betas=(c["beta1"], c["beta2"]),
                             weight_decay=c["weight_decay"])


def _lion_factory(g, params, c):
    # train_lion: Lion(lr=lion_lr, betas=(beta1, 0.99), weight_decay=lion_wd)
    return g.Lion(params, lr=c.get("lion_lr", 3e-4), betas=(c["beta1"], 0.99),
                  weight_decay=c.get("lion_wd", 3.0))


def _grokfast_factory(g, params, c):
    # train_grokfast: Grokfast(lr, betas=(beta1,beta2), weight_decay,
    #                          grokfast_alpha, grokfast_lamb)
    return g.Grokfast(params, lr=c["lr"], betas=(c["beta1"], c["beta2"]),
                      weight_decay=c["weight_decay"],
                      grokfast_alpha=c.get("grokfast_alpha", 0.98),
                      grokfast_lamb=c.get("grokfast_lamb", 2.0))

## Summary

I ported the committed decoder LookSAM L3-TC P2.4 phase (commit bab8914) to vit and mamba. Each step gated on a FRESH `FORCE_CUDA=1 ./build.sh` (exit 0, all 56 TUs linked, `_ops` imports).

### looksam/vit — CONVERTED, committed `fb997a9`
- **wiring_check**: `looksam/vit = L3-TC-megakernel(wgmma)`
- **tail_gate** (bit-identical): (1a) params vs eager rel=5.66e-08; (1b) state m=4.3e-8 v=3.1e-8; (1b-sam) sam_dir vs ViT bf16-faithful 2nd backward rel=1.36e-03 (tol 2e-2); **(2) A/A/A loss 4.726432/4.726432/4.726432, grad-eq+param-eq = bit-identical**
- **TF/s**: 4.194 TF/s (bf16 wgmma, B=16384, 5.0 steps/s)
- Files: `fused_vit_megakernel.cuh` (P2.4 + `vit_tc_looksam_floats` scratch after Muon), `mega_vit_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu` (st.sam_dir + case OptId::LookSAM), `dispatch.py` registries, `test_l3tc_tail_gate.py` (cell + ViT oracle branch).

### looksam/mamba — BLOCKED (landed-dormant + loud cited reason), committed `3725472`
- **wiring_check**: `looksam/mamba = eager` (BLOCKED, cited)
- The in-kernel P2.4 is fully and faithfully code-landed (mirrors the twins onto mamba tile fns; `fused_mamba_megakernel_tc<OptId 4>` links into `_ops`), if-constexpr'd so **mamba×{adamw,lion,grokfast} stay bit-identical A/A/A (4.754265×3)**.
- **Blocked because** the gate FAILS A/A/A: non-deterministic grad across bit-identical re-runs (loss spread ~5e-5, grad maxΔ~1e-3, intermittent NaN). **Measured even on a SAM-OFF step** (no 2nd backward) → it is the latent shared mamba scan/forward race (same class blocking mamba×prodigy), exposed by the LookSAM instantiation's occupancy profile — not my SAM code. The proxy tails (adamw/lion/grokfast) are bit-identical on the same forward, so the proxy couldn't predict it; the gate was the arbiter.
- Gated at both layers: Python registry (not in `_FUSED_L3_REAL`/`_L3_WGMMA_CELLS`) + C++ `mb_looksam` carve-out (env `SG_MAMBA_LOOKSAM_PROBE` to observe). Also fixed a latent bug: the mamba dispatch.cpp `FusedScalars` POD was truncated at `beta3`, leaving rho/looksam_sam (and aux_*) inert.
- **TF/s**: N/A (blocked → runs eager; no L3-TC cell to measure).

### Regression (all green on the final build)
- decoder + vit looksam tail_gate PASS; all 8 vit cells PASS (the vit template change didn't shift muon/prodigy/etc.); decoder looksam unchanged (1.409 TF/s).

Final state: looksam = decoder L3-TC-wgmma, vit L3-TC-wgmma, mamba eager(blocked).
